11/07/2025 Priya Raman 397 Linden Terrace Cypress Parish, LA 70123 (504) 555-0107 priya.raman@example.com I am writing to provide my account of what happened to my vehicle. On the morning of 11/06/2025 around 05:40, I went to my car in the Cypress Court residential parking lot, Cypress Parish, LA 70123, and discovered that it was sitting in standing floodwater. There had been heavy rain overnight and the parking area clearly flooded. My vehicle is a 2020 Volkswagen Jetta S, Black (VIN: 3VWC57BU3LA515467), LA license LA32831, used for personal commuting. When I opened the driver's door, water was inside up to the front floorboards. The carpeting was soaked on both the driver and passenger sides and there was moisture around the lower dash and center console. When I turned the key to the accessory position, several warning lights came on (battery, ABS, and traction control). Because of the water and the lights, I decided not to start or drive the car. I took photos and called my insurer to start a claim. My claim number is CDA-25-239878 and my policy number is CDA-A9636901 with Cypress Delta Assurance. I scheduled a tow and had the vehicle transported to the assessment facility the same morning. It has not been operated by me since I discovered it. From what I can see, the damage appears to be water intrusion to the floor and lower dash area, including possible electrical-module and harness issues, and interior contamination. I understand repair economics and a proposed total-loss value are still under review. I have not had any injuries and no other vehicle was involved. Please let me know if you need any more information from me. claim number is CDA-25-239878 and my policy number is
CDA-A9636901 with Cypress Delta Assurance. I scheduled
a tow and had the vehicle transported to the assessment
facility the same morning. It has not been operated by me
since I discovered it.

From what I can see, the damage appears to be water
intrusion to the floor and lower dash area, including possible
electrical-module and harness issues, and interior contamination.
I understand repair economics and a proposed total-loss value
are still under review.

I have not had any injuries and no other vehicle was
involved.

Please let me know if you need any more information
from me.

Thank you,
P.R.

summary.valueString: Priya Raman reported that on the morning of 11/06/2025 around 05:40, she found her 2020 Volkswagen Jetta S in standing floodwater in the Cypress Court residential parking lot after heavy overnight rain. She reported water inside up to the front floorboards, soaked carpeting, moisture around the lower dash and center console, warning lights when the key was turned to accessory, and possible electrical and interior contamination issues. She did not start or drive the car, took photos, contacted her insurer, scheduled a tow, and stated there were no injuries and no other vehicle involved.
